params.description: Parameter sets this environment reads, per role: `{customer: customer-acmep01}`, or a list per role merged in order. Any document of the extends chain may name sets: per role they merge root first, leaf last, later winning per leaf key. `${param:<role>.<key>}` in the spec of any document of the chain reads the merged values.

name_rule.description: The name every environment built on this one must have, with `${param:<role>.<key>}` tokens filled from that environment's parameter sets (`deploy-${param:customer.code}-env`). Only `${param:}` tokens are allowed.

tags.description: Optional tags (list of values for categorization)

EnvironmentSpecModel.description:
The values an environment supplies: the `variables`, `secrets` and `features` that `${var:KEY}`, `${secret:KEY}` and `${feature:KEY}` resolve against, plus shared `properties` and `custom` data.

Terraform receives resolved `constant` and `environment` variables as `strata.variables` and features as `strata.flags`. Secrets are never written to disk; they are delivered at deploy time.

Rules:
- Keys must be unique within each of `variables`, `secrets` and `features`. The same key may appear in different stores, because `${var:X}` and `${secret:X}` are different tokens.

partial.description: When true this is a base for other environments (`extends`), not an environment of its own: no deployment or tenant may list it in `environments`, and no `${value:}` token may read it.

extends.description: Name of a base Environment whose spec is merged into this one when the solution loads. Child always wins: `properties` and `custom` deep-merge per leaf key; a `variables`, `secrets` or `features` entry with the same `key` replaces the base's whole entry, and new keys are appended. Circular chains are rejected.

properties.description: Environment-wide properties, merged as a layer into the deployments that use this environment. Tenant properties merge first, then this environment's, then the deployment's own. The merged result is passed to Terraform as `strata.properties`.

custom.description: Free-form values merged like `properties` across the tenant, environment and deployment, passed to Terraform as `strata.custom`.

variables.description:
Variable declarations — what '${var:KEY}' tokens resolve against

Rules:
- On a `constant` store, `type` must match the value: `object` and `map` need a mapping, `list` a sequence, `number` a number and `bool` a boolean.
- `default` is only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant`, `environment` or `artifact`.
- `store: artifact` requires `field`, and `field` is only valid with `store: artifact`.

secrets.description:
Secret declarations — what '${secret:KEY}' tokens resolve against

Rules:
- `generate` and `rotate` are only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant`, `environment` or `github`.
- A `rotate` policy of `rotate` needs a `generate` spec, because strata cannot regenerate a secret it did not create. Use policy `warn` otherwise.
- `version` is not supported for the `github` store.

features.description:
Feature flag declarations — what '${feature:KEY}' tokens resolve against

Rules:
- `default` is only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant` or `environment`.

FeatureStoreModel.description:
A feature flag. `key` is what `${feature:KEY}` refers to; `store` and `value` say where it comes from. `value` is a literal for `constant`, an environment variable name for `environment`, and a flag name for an integration-backed store.

Rules:
- `default` is only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant` or `environment`.

key.description: Feature flag key name for referencing in configurations

store.description: Where the flag comes from: `constant`, `environment` or `azure-appconfig`. `flagsmith` is recognised but cannot be resolved yet. The Configuration's `spec.security.allowed_feature_stores` can restrict the allowed types.

value.description: Feature flag identifier: literal for constant, env var name for environment, flag name/key for integration-backed stores

version.description: Optional version for store-based feature flags

default.description: Seed the store with this state ('true'/'false') when the flag is missing (integration-backed stores only)

FeatureStoreType.description: Where a feature flag is read from: `constant` and `environment` are built in, `azure-appconfig` is resolved through an Integration. `flagsmith` is recognised but has no resolver yet.

SecretGenerateSpec.description: Spec for generating a cryptographically secure secret when the store key does not exist.

type.description: Generator type (urlsafe, hex, password, alphanumeric, numeric, base64, uuid4, uuid7)

length.description: Length in bytes (urlsafe/hex/base64) or characters (alphanumeric/password/numeric). Ignored for uuid4/uuid7.

SecretRotatePolicy.description: Rotation policy: warn (advisory only) or rotate (auto-regenerate).

SecretRotateSpec.description: Rotation policy for a secret — advisory warning or automatic regeneration.

max_age.description: Maximum secret age in days before the policy triggers

policy.description: 'warn' emits an advisory, 'rotate' auto-regenerates (requires a 'generate' spec)

SecretStoreModel.description:
A secret. `key` is what `${secret:KEY}` refers to; `store` and `value` say where it comes from. `value` is a literal for `constant`, an environment variable name for `environment`, a GitHub Actions secret name for `github`, and a path or ID for an integration-backed store.

Rules:
- `generate` and `rotate` are only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant`, `environment` or `github`.
- A `rotate` policy of `rotate` needs a `generate` spec, because strata cannot regenerate a secret it did not create. Use policy `warn` otherwise.
- `version` is not supported for the `github` store.

key.description: Secret key name for referencing in configurations

store.description: Where the secret comes from: `constant`, `environment`, `github`, `azure-keyvault` or `infisical`. `vault` and `bitwarden` are recognised but cannot be resolved yet. The Configuration's `spec.security.allowed_secret_stores` can restrict the allowed types.

value.description: Secret identifier: literal for constant, env var name for environment, GitHub Actions secret name for github, secret path/ID for integration-backed stores

generate.description: Auto-generate the secret when the store key is missing (integration-backed stores only)

rotate.description: Rotation policy: age-based advisory or automatic regeneration (integration-backed stores only)

SecretStoreType.description: Where a secret is read from: `constant`, `environment` and `github` are built in; `azure-keyvault` and `infisical` are resolved through an Integration. `vault` and `bitwarden` are recognised but have no resolver yet.

VariableStoreModel.description:
A variable. `key` is what `${var:KEY}` refers to; `store` and `value` say where it comes from. `value` is a literal for `constant`, an environment variable name for `environment`, an Artifact document name for `artifact`, and a path or key for an integration-backed store.

Rules:
- On a `constant` store, `type` must match the value: `object` and `map` need a mapping, `list` a sequence, `number` a number and `bool` a boolean.
- `default` is only valid for an integration-backed store, not for `constant`, `environment` or `artifact`.
- `store: artifact` requires `field`, and `field` is only valid with `store: artifact`.

key.description: Variable key name for referencing in configurations

store.description: Where the value comes from: `constant`, `environment`, `artifact`, `azure-appconfig` or `infisical`. `consul`, `vault` and `etcd` are recognised but cannot be resolved yet. The Configuration's `spec.security.allowed_variable_stores` can restrict the allowed types.

value.description: Literal for `constant`, environment variable name for `environment`, Artifact document name for `artifact`, path or key for an integration-backed store.

type.description: Declared HCL type for Terraform emission. Omitted means emitted as a string (backward compatible).

default.description: Seed the store with this value when the key is missing (integration-backed stores only)

field.description: Which field of the `store: artifact` target to read: image_name, image_tag (kind: version's pins.artifacts-overlaid; a tag, a digest or `tag@digest`), the synthesised image_ref ('{image_name}:{tag}@{digest}'), or one part of image_tag: image_tag_name (the tag) or image_digest. A part the value lacks is empty. Only valid on 'store: artifact'.

VariableStoreType.description: Where a variable is read from: `constant`, `environment` and `artifact` (an Artifact document) are built in; `azure-appconfig` and `infisical` are resolved through an Integration. `consul`, `vault` and `etcd` are recognised but have no resolver yet.

VariableValueType.description: Declared Terraform type used when a variable is emitted: `string` (the default), `number`, `bool`, `object`, `list` or `map`. Only checked against the value for `constant` stores.

ParamToken.description: Filled from the document's parameter sets when the solution loads (`${param:<role>.<key>}`).

description:
A source of values for value tokens: variables, secrets and feature flags, plus shared properties. A deployment lists environments in `environments`, merged in order with later ones winning; a tenant can contribute environments that merge first.

Rules:
- An environment cannot extend itself; longer extends cycles are rejected when the solution loads.

spec.description:
Environment specification (properties, variables, secrets, features)

Rules:
- Keys must be unique within each of `variables`, `secrets` and `features`. The same key may appear in different stores, because `${var:X}` and `${secret:X}` are different tokens.
